name: pubmed-stream
description: Search PubMed and PubMed Central, download open full texts, map the evidence around a paper and build an Obsidian knowledge graph, citing only what was read.

ncbi_api_key.title: NCBI API key
ncbi_api_key.description: Optional. A free key makes searches and downloads about three times faster: create it under API Key Management in the settings of your NCBI account (account.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/settings). Leave it empty to add it later with /plugin configure.
